# outbound_network (Resource)

An Outbound-managed network: Outbound gateways replace the NAT gateways of an existing VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "outbound_network" "main" {
  cloud_account_id = "123456789012"

  aws {
    region = "eu-west-1"
    vpc_id = "vpc-0abc123"
  }

  # One gateway per public subnet, serving the private subnets of its AZ.
  gateway {
    public_subnet_id   = "subnet-0a"
    private_subnet_ids = ["subnet-1a"]
  }

  gateway {
    public_subnet_id   = "subnet-0b"
    private_subnet_ids = ["subnet-1b"]
  }

  instance_type = "c7gn.medium"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) The onboarded cloud account that owns the VPC (for AWS, the account ID).

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Display name in the Outbound UI.
- `aws` (Block, Optional) The AWS VPC. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--aws))
- `gateway` (Block Set) One gateway per public subnet, with the private subnets it serves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--gateway))
- `hidden` (Boolean) Hide the network in the Outbound UI.
- `instance_type` (String) Gateway instance type, for all gateways. Defaults to Outbound's suggestion for the VPC.
- `release_ips_on_destroy` (Boolean) Release the pooled Elastic IPs when the network is destroyed. Kept IPs are reused by a later re-enable and block destroying the cloud account.
- `retain_replaced_nat_gateway` (Boolean) Keep the AWS NAT gateways Outbound replaces instead of deleting them.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `egress_ips` (List of String) Public IPs of the gateways, for allowlists.
- `gateway_ids` (List of String) Instance IDs of the gateways.
- `generation` (Number) Desired-state generation.
- `id` (String) Composite `<account>_<region>_<vpc-id>`; also the import ID.
- `last_error` (String) Why Outbound could not apply the latest change, if it failed.
- `observed_generation` (Number) Last generation Outbound applied; behind `generation` while a change is pending or failed.
- `status` (String) `monitored` or `inactive`.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-locking version.

Required:

- `region` (String) AWS region of the VPC.

Required:

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <account>_<region>_<vpc-id>
terraform import outbound_network.main 123456789012_eu-west-1_vpc-0abc123
```
